Edit files ONLY under the current working directory; NEVER edit anything under /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge directly (you may only run its .venv/bin/python). Do NOT git commit, do NOT git add -A, do NOT touch .git. No network, no live model call. Write short notes to /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/game-reimagination-phase1-notes/step8e-notes.md.

CONTEXT: Read .plans/phase1-live-smoke.md ('Result of smoke 1' and the smoke 2 evidence below), .plans/1c-contract-result.md, .plans/game-reimagination-phase1.md steps 3-6, docs/contributor-guide.md. Rules: the shared runtime is story-agnostic (no runtime code may name 1C, the freight terminal, prisoner numbers or any fact id of the continuity-initiative story); facts are the sole mutable truth; a missed window grants nothing earned; the engine must never silently supply an unearned achievement.

DEFECT (from two live runs, per-turn records in bench/results/phase1-slice-smoke-2/results.json if present, otherwise as described): in an incident scene whose incident is unresolved, RuntimeEngine._activate_pacing (storygame/runtime/engine.py ~line 1215) stages the legacy handoff once turns_since_entry >= handoff_after_turns (11 in 1C): staged_handoff_fact_ids becomes the bridge's missing delivery facts. The provider then delivers each staged fact's FactDelivery.fallback_text as the whole reply on every following turn (recovery_count +1 per turn), e.g. 'Kristin copies the prisoner numbers and matches them to missing-person records.', although the fact was never committed (committed_reveals empty, facts unchanged). The same line repeats every turn for 20 turns (stuck loop), tells the player a false outcome, and never retires. The deadline backstop already guards with self._unresolved_incident() (engine.py ~lines 311 and 1427); the handoff staging has no such guard. Incident-owned advantage facts are never to be delivered by the legacy handoff path.

GOAL: (1) Tests FIRST, confirmed failing before the fix: tests/test_incident_handoff_guard.py, hermetic with the scripted provider. On the real package AND on the incident synthetic fixture or lighthouse fixture used by tests/test_incident_engine.py (story-agnostic case): in an incident scene with the incident unresolved, advance past handoff_after_turns with unrelated accepted commands and assert staged_handoff_fact_ids stays empty, no fallback_text of any incident advantage appears in any response segment, the advantage facts stay unasserted, and the scene is left only by an earned outcome or the declared recovery. Also assert a non-incident scene (any ordinary scene on the real package) still stages its handoff at handoff_after_turns exactly as before (no behavior change there), and that the guard releases once the incident is resolved (staged handoff behavior for the resolved state is unchanged). (2) Fix: guard the handoff staging in _activate_pacing (and clear any staged handoff while the incident is unresolved) using the existing self._unresolved_incident() helper, with a one-line comment stating why. Check the other readers of staged_handoff_fact_ids (engine.py ~1424 and ~1464, knowledge.py ~274, narration_safety.py ~95 and ~132) and make sure no incident-owned fact can reach them; report in the notes what you found. Do not change data/** or pacing windows.

OWNED FILES: storygame/**, tests/*. Nothing else.

HOW TO RUN: first confirm PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)" prints a path inside the cwd. Focused: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov -n auto <files>. FULL suite must end green: same with no file args. Ruff on files you touch: -m ruff check --fix then -m ruff format. Do not run uv.

NOTES CONTRACT: step8e-notes.md with sections: TESTS (which failed before the fix), FIX, OTHER READERS CHECKED, TESTS UPDATED (any existing test that pinned the old behavior, with reason), OPEN QUESTIONS (or 'none'). Reply with a short summary.
